#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! -f cuda/cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64/libcudart.so.12 ]]; then
    curl -fsSL https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b12242/cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz -o cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz
    printf '%s\n' 'fc33b4280968cb645f98fa78ae6377e40911ff08292161b3aa02df3c6a94ee57  cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c
    mkdir -p cuda
    tar xzf cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64.tar.gz -C cuda
fi
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD:$PWD/cuda/cudart-llama-b12242-bin-ubuntu-cuda-12.8-x64"
exec ./llama-server -m weights/Inkling-2-Mini-UD-Q2_K_XL.gguf --alias inkling-2-mini-ud-q2-k-xl --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18392 -c 131072 -np 1 -ub 512 -b 512 -fa on -ctk q4_0 -ctv q4_0 --jinja --cors-origins localhost --mmproj weights/mmproj-F16.gguf --no-mmproj-offload --reasoning-effort none
